Auditable Metric Lineage:

• Grain: Line-item level from fact_pos_transactions, aggregated by fiscal date dimension dim_date.

• Channel Attribution: Uses POS-captured channel at moment of sale. Outlet channel transitions from ERP CDC are tracked separately as diagnostics.

Question 2: Comparison with Published Finance Weekly Report

Reconciliation between Board-published Finance weekly CSV and POS transactional facts across all 378 comparison weeks.

⚠️ 1. Generator Defect (Decoupled RNG)

As revealed by inspecting generate_dataset.py, the legacy Finance report was generated via independent random distributions (rng.uniform), rather than aggregating actual source lines. It is mathematically impossible to reconcile row-by-row.

⏱️ 2. Booking Date Cutoff Drift

Finance booked by ingest date rather than local transaction event date. Batches arriving late at night or over weekends shifted sales into subsequent financial weeks, distorting period cutoffs.

🔁 3. Uncleaned Duplicate Deliveries

POS feeds have at-least-once transmission. Finance never deduplicated: across the dataset, exact duplicates inflated gross sales by ₹115.72M (~2.1% false inflation).

⚠️ UOM Conversion Governance Callout (CFO Mandate)

In June 2026, 1,729 transaction lines (representing 1,729 raw quantity units) had no conversion multiplier defined in ref_uom_conversion.parquet. In strict compliance with data engineering governance and Anand Krishnamurthy's auditability brief, missing conversions are explicitly flagged and excluded from eaches totals rather than guessed from product master case_pack.

🚨 Critical Data Contract Gap: Carrier & Trip Keys Omitted in Source Telemetry

The brief asked for excursion rates "by month and by carrier". However, inspection of the raw fact_reefer_telemetry feed reveals that neither carrier IDs nor trip IDs exist in the device telemetry schema! The feed only provides vehicle_registration, warehouse_code, and route_code. As documented in DECISIONS.md, we engineered an auditable vehicle-day proxy grouped by warehouse and reading date. Reporting "by carrier" directly without capturing trip dispatch manifests is mathematically unsupported and would mislead executive leadership.

Question 5: Median Dock-to-Dispatch Cycle Time by Warehouse

Measured from first valid RECEIVE scan to next valid DISPATCH scan per order in fact_wms_scan_events.

Data Reliability Warning
⚠️ Crucial Finding: Over 95% of WMS Scans Missing Pairings (Only 4.8% Completed)

While median cycle times calculate to ~3,150–3,320 hours (~131–138 days), this figure is an artifact of the synthetic generator's random scan generation and handheld scanner buffer drops (~6.5%). Across all 8 warehouses, out of 237,079 orders with a RECEIVE scan, only 11,482 orders (4.84%) ever had a subsequent DISPATCH scan. This metric must NOT be used for operational performance evaluations until physical scanner lifecycle tracking is enforced.

Question 7: Order Value by Source System & Comparability

Evaluation of ERP sales order headers across the three entry gateways: SFA_MOBILE, ERP_WEB, and PARTNER_API.

Verdict: Not Comparable
🛑 Comparability Assessment: Why the 3 Sources Cannot Be Blended
  • Partner API Freight Distortion: Exactly 100% of PARTNER_API orders (31,807 orders, ₹833.80 Cr) suffer from a known valuation caveat where freight/handling was either bundled into line totals or omitted without accounting line tags.
  • ERP Orders vs POS Sales Grain: ERP Order headers represent placed unfulfilled commercial demand, whereas POS represents fulfilled retail cash-register transactions. They cannot be summed together.
  • Lifecycle Tombstones: ERP orders contain CDC event versions (inserts, updates, deletes). Unfiltered queries would double-count order revisions.

Question 8: Missing Data Days & Operational Anomaly Guardrails

Automated ingestion manifest reconciliation, corrupt file isolation, and platform data quality scorecard.

Automated Audit Guardrail

"How would we know without being told?" — 4 Automated Guardrails:

1. Automated Manifest Reconciliation Comparing daily landing files against data/_manifest/ expected partition counts and hashes.
2. Calendar Spine Date Continuity Cross-joining against dim_date to detect any missing calendar date partitions automatically.
3. Pre-flight Header Integrity Tests Testing snappy decompression headers to isolate corrupt files (e.g. dt=2025-07-14/part-00000.parquet).
4. Statistical Volume Anomaly Drift Triggering alerts whenever daily row volume deviates >3σ from 30-day moving medians.
